name: Integrity Factoring
summary: Flat-fee factoring for small and mid-sized carriers with recourse and non-recourse options and a free fuel card.
differentiator: Publishes a guide to the fees other factors hide, with ranges (wire $10 to $30, lockbox $50 to $100 a month), but not its own flat fee. Useful as a checklist; ask Integrity for its own numbers against it.
